## Coordina

Coordina is a Rhino 8 plug-in designed and developed by Ehsan Mokhtary (also published as Ehsan Mokhtari). It provides local model version control and optional cloud collaboration in an adjustable Rhino sidebar.

Key capabilities include local 3DM commits, version history, safe model restoration, cloud project versions, teammate commits, team invitations, shared chat, viewport screenshots and issue tracking. Local mode is free and works offline without an account. The basic cloud plan includes 500 MB of storage. Coordina requires Rhino 8.26 or later on Windows with Rhino's default .NET 7 runtime.

- Product website: https://coordina.ehsanmo.me/
- Food4Rhino listing: https://www.food4rhino.com/en/app/coordina

## Other software

RhinoPlus is a Rhino production toolkit by Ehsan Mokhtary for repeated modelling, documentation, metadata and fabrication workflows.

- Food4Rhino listing: https://www.food4rhino.com/en/app/rhinoplus
